headline: Armenia Proposes New Constitution In Major Step Toward Peace With Azerbaijan
label: NEWS
caption:
Could this finally bring lasting peace to the region 🇦🇪🇵🇰

According to Reuters and Arab News, Armenia has proposed a new constitution as a step toward peace with Azerbaijan.

The announcement comes amid ongoing diplomatic efforts between the two neighboring countries.

Further details on the contents of the proposed constitutional changes and the timeline for implementation were not immediately detailed in the reports.
